Create `solution.py` using only the Python standard library. Implement `collect_terminals(tree)`. A node must be a dictionary with exactly `"name"`, `"details"`, and `"children"`. `name` must be a non-empty string, `details` must be either `None` or a dictionary with exactly the string keys `"category"` and `"region"`, and `children` must be a list of nodes. A terminal node is one whose `details` is not `None`; terminal nodes must have an empty `children` list. Non-terminal nodes must have at least one child. Raise `TypeError` for incorrect container/value types and `ValueError` for bad keys, empty required strings, or structural violations. Return a new list of dictionaries containing `"name"`, `"category"`, and `"region"`, ordered by depth-first traversal in the original child order. Deep-copy returned values, retain no aliases to the input, and never mutate it.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
